hook: Fifteen questions, no second chances. Can you score fifteen out of fifteen? Let us find out.

questions.question: Which gas do plants take in from the air for photosynthesis?
questions.question_speech: Question one. Which gas do plants take in from the air for photosynthesis? A. Oxygen. B. Carbon dioxide. C. Nitrogen. D. Helium.

questions.question: Which part of a plant absorbs water from the soil?
questions.question_speech: Question two. Which part of a plant absorbs water from the soil? A. The stem. B. The leaves. C. The petals. D. The roots.

questions.question: Which tree species is the tallest in the world?
questions.question_speech: Question three. Which tree species is the tallest in the world? A. Coast redwood. B. Baobab. C. Oak. D. Pine.

questions.question: Which plant produces the largest single flower in the world?
questions.question_speech: Question four. Which plant produces the largest single flower in the world? A. Lotus. B. Rafflesia. C. Sunflower. D. Orchid.

questions.question: What is the green pigment in plant leaves called?
questions.question_speech: Question five. What is the green pigment in plant leaves called? A. Melanin. B. Keratin. C. Hemoglobin. D. Chlorophyll.

questions.question: Which tree produces dates?
questions.question_speech: Question six. Which tree produces dates? A. The olive tree. B. The fig tree. C. The date palm. D. The pine tree.
questions.answer_speech: C is correct, The date palm.

questions.question: Which plant group includes some of the fastest-growing plants, up to about a meter a day?
questions.question_speech: Question seven. Which plant group includes some of the fastest-growing plants, up to about a meter a day? A. Bamboo. B. Fern. C. Moss. D. Cactus.

questions.question: Acorns are the fruit of which tree?
questions.question_speech: Question eight. Acorns are the fruit of which tree? A. Willow. B. Birch. C. Maple. D. Oak.

questions.question: What does a Venus flytrap mostly catch and digest?
questions.question_speech: Question nine. What does a Venus flytrap mostly catch and digest? A. Birds. B. Insects. C. Seeds. D. Fish.

questions.question: From which tree is maple syrup mainly made?
questions.question_speech: Question ten. From which tree is maple syrup mainly made? A. Elm. B. Birch. C. Sugar maple. D. Cedar.

questions.question: Which part of a flowering plant produces seeds?
questions.question_speech: Question eleven. Which part of a flowering plant produces seeds? A. The bark. B. The flower. C. The stem. D. The root.

questions.question: Cacti survive in deserts mainly by doing what?
questions.question_speech: Question twelve. Cacti survive in deserts mainly by doing what? A. Drinking dew with leaves. B. Living underground. C. Storing water in their stems. D. Growing very tall.
questions.answer_speech: C is correct, Storing water in their stems.

questions.question: Which spice comes from the dried stigmas of a crocus flower?
questions.question_speech: Question thirteen. Which spice comes from the dried stigmas of a crocus flower? A. Turmeric. B. Cumin. C. Paprika. D. Saffron.

questions.question: Which tree is the source of olive oil?
questions.question_speech: Question fourteen. Which tree is the source of olive oil? A. The olive tree. B. The almond tree. C. The walnut tree. D. The palm tree.
questions.answer_speech: A is correct, The olive tree.

questions.question: What is the process of plants releasing water vapor from their leaves called?
questions.question_speech: Question fifteen. What is the process of plants releasing water vapor from their leaves called? A. Respiration. B. Germination. C. Transpiration. D. Pollination.
